_units.postfx_windscreen: m, cabin frame: the windscreen's glass as the eye sees it: left, bottom, right, top, then the z of its plane
_units.postfx_window_left: m, cabin frame: the driver's side glass as the eye sees it: front (z), bottom, back (z), top, then the x of its plane
_units.postfx_window_right: m, cabin frame: the passenger's side glass, likewise
_units.postfx_glass_feather: m on the glass over which an effect fades in at the window's frame
_units.postfx_demist_strip: m of windscreen above the dash: clear of haze, blur and cracks up to the first (what stands on the dash stays readable), their full strength from the second
_units.postfx_fade_time: s an effect takes to go from nothing to 1 (one that stops short of 1, like Haze, is there sooner)
_units.postfx_blink_time: s the lids take to shut, and to open again, in a Blink or a Nod
_units.postfx_flash_hold: s an effect keeps going one way before it may turn back (1/6 s is three flashes a second, GDD 16.4)
_units.postfx_tunnel_strength: opacity of the dark edges where they are darkest, 0 to 1
_units.postfx_tunnel_feather: share of half the view over which the dark edges fade in
_units.postfx_tunnel_onset: share of the Tunnel's way (0 at tunnel_from, 1 at snap_at) over which the dark edges come up to their strength
_units.postfx_lid_feather: share of the view's height over which a bar's edge fades
_units.postfx_lid_curve: how much further a bar reaches at the sides of the view than in its middle, as a share of its reach
_units.postfx_haze_color: colour of smoke on the glass (dust takes sky_color_dust)
_units.postfx_haze_mottle: share by which the haze thins in patches, 0 to 1 (it is never thicker than the snapshot says)
_units.postfx_haze_patch: m across one patch of haze on the glass
_units.postfx_haze_drift: patches per s the haze drifts across the glass
_units.postfx_rain_blur_radius: share of the view's height over which the fully blurred view is smeared
_units.postfx_rain_streak_alpha: opacity of a streak of rain, 0 to 1
_units.postfx_rain_streak_speed: view heights per s the rain falls
_units.postfx_rain_streak_slant: sideways run of the rain per unit of fall
_units.postfx_rain_streak_density: streak cells per view height: across, along
_units.postfx_rain_streak_width: share of a cell's width that a streak is wide
_units.postfx_crack_center: where on the windscreen the web of cracks is centred: share across from the driver's side, share up
_units.postfx_crack_spokes: shards around the point of impact
_units.postfx_crack_shift: share of the view's height by which a shard shifts what is seen through it
_units.postfx_crack_frost: opacity of the crushed glass at the point of impact, 0 to 1
_units.postfx_crack_core: share of the web's reach, from the point of impact, over which the crushed glass thins out
_units.postfx_crack_fray: share of the web's reach over which it frays out at its rim
_units.postfx_glare_radius: share of the view's height from the light at which the wash has faded to about a third
_units.postfx_glare_core: share of the view's height: the size of the light itself, a blaze in the middle of the wash
_units.postfx_glare_position: degrees right of straight ahead and above the horizon: where the light is when the snapshot does not say (the motorcade's spotlight)
_units.postfx_glare_cabin_share: share of the wash that falls on the cabin's own surfaces, 0 to 1
_units.postfx_night_darkness: share of the light the night takes from what the headlights do not reach, 0 to 1 (sunglasses and tinted glass take their share of the rest)
_units.postfx_cabin_darkness_share: share of the darkness that falls on the cabin (the dashboard glows), 0 to 1
_units.postfx_beam_aim: degrees right of straight ahead and above the horizon: the middle of the headlights' pool
_units.postfx_beam_size: degrees: half the width and half the height of the headlights' pool at low beam (it grows and shrinks with how far the headlights let him see; dust in the air does not shrink it)
_units.postfx_beam_feather: share of the pool's size over which its edge fades, 0 to 1
_units.cabin_center_x: m, the car's centre line in the cabin frame
_units.cabin_center_z: m, the car's centre in the cabin frame
_units.road_y: m, the road surface in the cabin frame
_units.road_mesh_step: m between road mesh rows (so the road can bend)
_units.world_bend_per_k: 1/m of sideways bend per unit of curve k
_units.sky_color_dust: colour of the sky and of the haze in a dust haze
_units.fog_near_share: share of how far he can see at which things begin to fade
_units.rail_period: m, length of one piece of guardrail
_units.sign_inset: m a road sign stands inside the guardrail
_units.vehicle_sign_lift: m above a vehicle's roof for a sign it carries
_units.fork_sign_height: m above the road for the fork's overhead sign
_units.sky_dawn_from: share of the night gone at which the sky begins to lighten
_units.stop_vendor_pos: m, cabin frame: where the vendor stands at the passenger window
_units.stop_tray_pos: m, cabin frame: the middle of the vendor's tray
_units.stop_shelf_pos: m, cabin frame: the middle of the tray's upper row
_units.phone_ring_bob: m the ringing phone rises on its mount
_units.phone_ring_hz: Hz of that (under 3: nothing flashes faster, GDD 16.4)
_units.ghost_alpha: opacity of the Phantom's ghost hand, 0 to 1
_units.fork_boss_text_lift: m above the branches' texts: where the boss ahead is written
_units.sky_boss_dawn: share of day in the sky at Dawn's start and at its end, outside a Telling
_units.sky_distance: m from his eye to the sun and to the glow
_units.sky_side_deg: degrees left or right of dead ahead at side 1
_units.sun_position: degrees: how far to the right of straight ahead the low sun stands at sun_side 1 (to the left at -1), and how high above the horizon with all of its Glare (in the windscreen, where the lowered visor covers it)
_units.sun_rise_from: degrees above the horizon: where the sun stands before its Glare comes on
_units.sky_glow_deg: degrees above the horizon, the middle of the glow
_units.soldier_post_ahead: m beyond the bar: where the soldier waits
_units.soldier_stand: m, x and z in the cabin frame: where the soldier stands for the papers
_units.soldier_sign_offset: m: his sign, toward the car and above the road
_units.gust_streak_ahead: m ahead of the car, nearest and farthest
_units.gust_streak_across: m, the width of the band they blow across
_units.gust_streak_height: m above the road, lowest and highest
_units.mirror_light_grow: scale of the lights in the mirror: first seen, at the bump
_units.mirror_light_spread: m from the mirror's middle to each light: first seen, at the bump
_units.glovebox_cell_pos: m, cabin frame: between the glovebox's cells, on its open door
_units.glovebox_cell_spread: m from there to each cell
_units.sway_view_roll: degrees the camera rolls per m/s of Sway
_units.stop_label_lift: m above an offer for its label
_units.stop_stall_offset: m to the right of the car and ahead of it: where the stall stands
_units.passenger_pos: m, cabin frame: the middle of the passenger in the seat
_units.passenger_sleep_tilt: degrees a sleeping passenger leans toward the door
_units.passenger_arm_from: m, cabin frame: the passenger's near shoulder, where an arm he reaches out with begins
_units.drum_pos: m, cabin frame: the drum, on the right of the dash
_units.drum_bob: m the drum moves while it is played
_units.drum_hz: beats per second of the drum's bob
_units.hitcher_pos: m, cabin frame: where a hitcher stands, beside the front wing on the passenger's side
_units.hitcher_sign_lift: m above the hitcher's middle: the name over their head
_units.free_traffic_per_km: vehicles per km in the sandbox road
_units.arm_pole: direction the elbow leans, cabin frame
_units.gate_view_scale: m of knob travel per gate unit
_units.cash_per_note: cash each note in the stack stands for
_units.item_lift: m an item is drawn above its slot's anchor
_units.subtitle_line_chars: characters in one line of a subtitle (GDD 16.6)
_units.subtitle_max_lines: lines of a subtitle on screen at once (GDD 16.6); a longer text is shown in parts
_units.subtitle_min_duration: s, the shortest time a subtitle is held (GDD 16.6)
_units.subtitle_char_duration: s per character a subtitle is held, if that is longer (GDD 16.6)
_units.subtitle_font_sizes: px at 1080p, for each size of the Subtitles setting (GDD 17.1)
_units.subtitle_speaker_scale: size of the speaker tag as a share of the text's
_units.subtitle_outline_share: width of the letters' outline as a share of their size
_units.subtitle_line_spacing: px at 1080p between the two lines
_units.subtitle_speaker_gap: px at 1080p between the speaker tag and the text
_units.subtitle_bottom_margin: px at 1080p from the bottom of the screen to the subtitle
_units.subtitle_padding: px at 1080p between the text and the edge of its background: sideways, up and down
_units.subtitle_corner_radius: px at 1080p, the background's rounded corners
_units.subtitle_background_color: colour of the background (the Subtitles setting turns it off)
_units.hand_plane_distance: m in front of the eye
_units.hand_free_bounds_min: m; x, y of the free-hand box on the hand plane
_units.hand_free_bounds_max: m; x, y of the free-hand box on the hand plane
_units.crank_min_step: px of pointer travel per heading sample
_units.crank_max_turn: degrees; a larger change of heading between two samples is a change of direction, not turning
_units.lat_per_kmh: m/s per km/h at full lock
_units.curve_k: m/s at 100 km/h: gentle, medium, sharp
_units.drift_fade_speed: km/h; below it every sideways drift is scaled by speed / drift_fade_speed (none at rest)
_units.hit_forced_gear: gear after a crash or head-on
_units.traffic_follow_gap: m a vehicle keeps behind the one ahead
_units.tunnel_min_view: share of the view left at Nerves 100
_units.visor_view_block: share of the view, from the top
_units.radio_step_px: px of dial drag per station
_units.beat_lengths: m, shortest and longest beat of each type (GDD 9.2)
_units.hitcher_chance: share of fuel stations and tea stalls at which a hitcher stands (0 to 1)
_units.exit_slip_length: m from where the Exit's slip lane opens to the stall (GDD 9.5: 2,200 m to 2,330 m)
_units.stop_leave_grip: s of gripping the wheel that leaves a stop (GDD 9.6)
_units.fork_sign_lead: s at par speed before the gore at which the fork's sign stands
_units.traffic_per_act: vehicles per km added in each act after the first
_units.modifier_chance: share of legs with a modifier, acts 1 to 3
_units.boss_modifier_chance: share of Tellings in which the act's boss has one of its two modifiers, acts 1 to 3
_units.late_signaller_share: share of lane changes signalled late, acts 1 to 3
_units.slip_sign_lead: s at par speed before a slip lane opens (the Exit of GDD 9.5; the Motorcade's side road)
_units.curve_ramp: m over which a curve's push comes on and goes off
_units.rain_response_mult: multiplier on the car's sideways response time
_units.gen_block_margin: m of clear road kept ahead of and behind each vehicle
_units.gen_lane_change: m in which both lanes must be free to change lane
_units.gen_oncoming_clear_time: s the oncoming lane must be left before an oncoming vehicle
_units.gen_max_attempts: redraws of a leg before the generator falls back to sparse traffic
_units.gen_sparse_attempts: redraws with sparse traffic before the generator gives up
_units.gen_filler_tries: tries to place each vehicle added for density
_units.gen_filler_max_speed: km/h, the fastest vehicle added for density that is met in third gear
_units.gen_filler_shares: shares of vehicles added for density: queued behind another, slow on its own, faster than third gear
_units.gen_fast_speed: km/h, lowest and highest speed of traffic faster than third gear
_units.gen_queue_max: vehicles in one queue, the one that holds it up included
_units.gen_path_filler_share: share of slow vehicles added for density that may be put on the planned line
_units.gen_spawn_clearance: m bumper to bumper between two vehicles in one lane of a plan (more than traffic_follow_gap)
_units.gen_min_gap: m bumper to bumper between two vehicles in one lane that are pulling apart
_units.spawn_clearance: m bumper to bumper below which a vehicle waits to appear (less than gen_min_gap)
_units.gen_beat_shifts: m later that a beat's vehicles are tried when they do not fit where the beat puts them
_units.gen_opening_gust_chance: chance that a leg opens with a gust before its first event
_units.gen_calm_deadlines: shares of the leg by which the first and the second CALM beat must have begun, lowest to highest
_units.suspicion_legal_gears: gears that do not raise Suspicion
_units.suspicion_snap: points for a Snap while the law is watching: a Patrol, the Checkpoint
_units.suspicion_honk: points for honking during a Patrol
_units.patrol_catch_up: km/h the police car drops when the Patrol is over, to fall back
_units.patrol_spawn_behind: m behind him at which the police car appears
_units.hook_settle_time: s for the hook to bring the car back to the middle of its lane (Wheel ring + Spinner knob)
_units.phantom_flinch_from: Nerves from which a cross-reach flinches (GDD 7.9)
_units.phantom_flinch_delay: s the real hand leaves late
_units.phantom_cramp_at: share of a Rain or Night leg's length at which the hum begins
_units.phantom_cramp_hum: s of hum before the cramp
_units.phantom_cramp_length: s the hand can neither let go nor take hold
